notes.title: Update to Version 0.2
notes.content:
Hey folks,

the first major update for Medieval Knight (Version 0.2) is now available. I have been working on it for almost 2 months. The Game is now running on Unity Engine and I have reworked core features. Unfortunately, I forgot to mark the features and menus that are still WIP or have no functionality, which I will resolve soon with a small fix.

notes.title: News regarding Version 0.2
notes.content:
Hey folks, it's been some time since the last update.

I have been working on a port to Unity, which has some new features and enhancements like:
[list]
[*] Menu Navigation by Clicking
[*] Optimized Save Game (and Steam Cloud-Support)
[*] Discord Rich Presence
[*] Steam Enhanced Rich Presence
[*] New Character Creation
[*] Settlement Creation (Work in Progress)
[/list]
This port still does not represent the state of the original game. I still need to port and enhance:
[list]
[*] Settlement Administration
[*] Building Management
[*] Procedural Generation of the Map
[*] Map Overview
[/list]
After completing the port I will work on every other aspect I have planned for Medieval Knight such as:
[list]
[*] War
[*] Diplomacy
[*] Dynasty
[*] Events
[/list]
I am aiming to release a public beta branch for the Unity port in early to mid-March, so you can easily follow my progress. You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/Xj3Cv25fMQ]Discord Server[/url] for more information and sneak peeks.

Kind regards,

Max
